requests.history_intro: Your home, one task at a time. Review the requests you have submitted.
requests.empty_title: A fresh start for your home
requests.empty_body: You have no service requests yet. Choose a service and tell us what needs attention.
requests.title_hint: For example, a leaking kitchen tap
requests.description_hint: What happened, when did it start, and what should a professional know?
requests.photo_guidance: Up to 3 JPEG or PNG photos, 5 MiB each. Avoid IDs, faces, and private documents. Images may contain embedded metadata; nothing is uploaded until you submit.
requests.private_photos_note: Photos remain private to your account, including after quote acceptance, and load only when you open them.
requests.location_note: Enter the location yourself. Salhly does not access your device location. Your address stays private unless you explicitly accept a quote and share it with the selected provider.
requests.address_hint: Street, building, and any helpful access details
requests.time_note: Shown in your device's local time. This is a preference, not a confirmed appointment.
requests.review_note: Your request, address, and photos will be stored privately. After submission, publishing a separate summary and accepting a quote each require your explicit choice. Photos stay owner-only even after acceptance.
requests.consent: I confirm these details and agree to store this location and any selected photos with my private request.
requests.wait_submission: Wait for the current submission to finish before leaving.
requests.discard_body: These unsaved details and selected photos will be removed from this page. No request will be submitted.
requests.leave_pending_body: Your submission could not be confirmed. It may already be saved. Check My requests before starting another request; leaving will clear this local draft.
requests.cancel_body: The request will remain in your history. Its photos will stay private and will not be deleted by cancellation.

marketplace.demo_summary: Synthetic accounts and local records only
marketplace.demo_body: Use sample information only. As the demo customer, create a plumbing request, then publish a NEW summary and the city Cairo. Sign out and sign in as marketplace-provider@salahly.demo with password Salahly123! to send a quote. This distinct account is Sample Marketplace Provider, a synthetic eligible plumbing provider serving Cairo, not a real credential review. The ordinary provider account and new submissions remain pending or ineligible. Switch back to the customer to accept, then to the sample provider to record work progress. Only the customer confirms completion. No quotes or jobs are created automatically; everything resets when the app restarts.
marketplace.feed_intro: Customer-published requests for your current service eligibility. Listings appear by publication time, not ranking or distance.
marketplace.feed_privacy: Before acceptance, only the separate public summary, city, and service category are shared. Original request details, photos, customer identity, and contact information are not shown here.
marketplace.my_quotes_intro: Review the terms you submitted. Pending quotes can be updated or withdrawn while the request remains open; withdrawn quotes can be reactivated if you are still eligible.
marketplace.feed_empty_body: Customers must explicitly publish a listing first. Refresh to check for new listings that match an active service and a service-area label in your current profile.
marketplace.my_quotes_empty: Browse published requests and choose one to send your first quote.
marketplace.customer_quotes_empty: Eligible providers may submit quotes for this listing. Refresh to check; no quotes or notifications are generated automatically.
marketplace.ineligible_title: Quoting is not available for this profile
marketplace.ineligible_body: New quotes require a currently verified provider profile, a matching active service, and a matching city or district label in your service areas. Matching ignores surrounding spaces and letter case; it does not use GPS, distance, rankings, or weekly availability. Creating an account or submitting a credential is not approval.
marketplace.publish_intro: Your saved request is still private. To invite quotes, write a NEW public summary and city below. Neither field is copied from your private request or profile.
marketplace.public_guidance: Use 10 to 1,000 characters for the summary and 2 to 100 for a broad city or district. Do not include your name, phone, email, exact address, building or unit, location identifiers, or GPS coordinates. Only this separate summary, city, and service category will be visible to eligible providers.
marketplace.publish_consent: I reviewed this NEW summary and city. I agree to share them and the service category with eligible providers. I have not included contact details or identifiers that reveal my precise location. My original request and photos remain private at this step.
marketplace.published_privacy: Only this listing is shared before you accept a quote. Publishing does not share the original title, description, address, preferred time, or photos. Published wording cannot be edited here.
marketplace.compare_note: Review each provider's name, price, estimated duration, notes, and revision. Quotes are not ranked. Refresh for the latest terms; an outdated revision cannot be accepted.
marketplace.quote_rules: Price is in EGP only, from 0.01 to 1,000,000.00, with at most two decimal places and no grouping separators. Duration must be a whole number from 1 to 43,200 minutes, not an appointment or arrival estimate. Notes may contain up to 1,000 characters.
marketplace.quote_disclosure: Submitting or updating shares your saved provider name and these quote terms with the requesting customer. Your credential, email, and phone are not shared by this action. Avoid adding contact details to your notes.
marketplace.withdraw_body: Your last submitted quote will be withdrawn. Unsaved edits will not be saved. You can reactivate it while the request is open if you remain eligible.
marketplace.quote_saved: Your quote terms have been saved.
marketplace.quote_closed: This request is no longer open for quotes. Accepted terms are frozen; use My jobs to see a selected job.
marketplace.accept_consent: By accepting, I authorize this selected provider to see my original request title, description, city, address, and preferred time. The preferred time is a preference, not an appointment. Photos stay owner-only; contact details and credentials are not shared by this action. The displayed quote revision is frozen for the job, other pending quotes are closed, and no payment is made here.
marketplace.accepted_notice: Quote accepted. Your job is ready to review.
marketplace.frozen_terms: These are the accepted price, duration, and notes. They cannot be edited. No payment, appointment, or arrival time is confirmed here.
marketplace.request_closed: This request is cancelled and cannot receive or accept quotes.
marketplace.jobs_intro: Jobs begin only after a customer accepts a quote. Follow recorded status changes; only the customer can confirm completion.
marketplace.jobs_empty_body: An accepted quote creates a job for its customer and selected provider. No sample jobs are added automatically.
marketplace.job_privacy: The original request text, city, address, and preferred time are shared only with this job's participants after acceptance. Request photos remain owner-only. No contact details or credential images are included.
marketplace.history_note: Only actions actually recorded for this job appear here. Dates use your device's local time.

job_hint.selected: The provider can mark on the way or start work directly. Either participant may cancel before work starts.
job_hint.on_the_way: The provider recorded being on the way. No GPS tracking or arrival estimate is provided. Either participant may cancel before work starts.
job_hint.in_progress: Work has been marked as started. The provider can request completion confirmation when finished. Cancellation is no longer available.
job_hint.awaiting_confirmation: The provider reports the work is finished. Only the requesting customer can confirm completion.
job_hint.completed: The customer confirmed completion. This job is closed and cannot be reopened. No payment is recorded here.
job_hint.cancelled: This job was cancelled before work started. It is closed and cannot be reopened.

job_confirm.on_the_way: Record that you are on the way. This does not share your location or promise an arrival time.
job_confirm.in_progress: Record that work has started. Neither participant can cancel the job through this flow after this step.
job_confirm.awaiting_confirmation: Record that the work is finished and ask the customer to confirm it. This does not complete the job automatically.
job_confirm.completed: Confirm that the work is complete. This permanently closes the job. It does not record a payment or create a review.
job_confirm.cancelled: Cancel this job before work starts. This is final: the request and accepted terms will remain in history, and the job cannot be reopened.

marketplace.pending_note: The original action is still unresolved. Editing, other choices, and status changes are paused until its exact retry resolves.
marketplace.resolve_before_leaving: Retry the original action before leaving this page. Its outcome is still unknown.
marketplace.wait_operation: Wait for the current action to finish before leaving.
marketplace.discard_body: Your unsent public summary or quote edits will be removed from this page. Previously saved records will not change.
marketplace.reload_body: Unsaved quote edits will be replaced by the latest submitted terms. Review the new revision before sending again.

errors.not_found: This listing, quote, or job is unavailable to your account.
errors.invalid: These details could not be validated. Refresh and review them before trying again.
errors.consent: Review the sharing information and explicitly confirm before continuing.
errors.summary: Write a new public summary using 10 to 1,000 characters, without contact or precise location identifiers.
errors.city: Enter a broad public city or district using 2 to 100 characters, not an address.
errors.ineligible: Your current verification, active service, or service-area label does not make you eligible for this listing.
errors.amount: Enter an EGP price from 0.01 to 1,000,000.00 with at most two decimal places. Do not use grouping separators or exponents.
errors.duration: Enter a whole number of estimated minutes from 1 to 43,200.
errors.currency: Quotes and jobs support EGP only.
errors.conflict: The recorded terms or status changed. Nothing has been accepted on these outdated terms. Refresh and review the latest record.
errors.status: This action is not allowed in the current status. Refresh to see the recorded result.
errors.unpublished: The customer has not published a separate listing for quotes.
errors.busy: Wait for the current marketplace action to finish.
errors.load_failed: The marketplace records could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
errors.uncertain: The result of your original action is still unknown. Keep its details unchanged and retry the original action before editing, choosing another provider, or changing status.

matching.title: Matching
matching.heading: Providers for this request
matching.intro: For your own published, open request only. Every candidate must currently have verified credentials, the matching active service and service-area label, and explicit consent to discovery. Self-reported skills are not individual certifications.
matching.no_action: Exploring a provider does not invite, book, or select anyone. A job starts only when you review and accept an actual quote in Quotes and sharing.
matching.not_a_quote: This is a matching suggestion, not a quote or an offer to book.
matching.eligible_label: Currently eligible and opted in for this request
matching.recommended_note: Ordered by the configured total score, then a deterministic request-specific tie order. Missing evidence does not remove an eligible provider.
matching.all_note: All eligible providers, including low scores and missing signals. This view uses a deterministic request-specific order, not a score threshold, name, signup date, or completed-job count.
matching.evidence_note: Evidence coverage is the share of configured factor weight with available data. It is not statistical confidence or a guarantee of suitability. A neutral value is not measured evidence.
matching.factor_numbers: Normalized score {score}/100; weight {weight}/{total}; contribution {contribution}/100 to the total.
matching.factor_neutral: No evidence for this factor. Its fixed neutral value is {neutral}/100, not a measured result.
matching.reason_unavailable: No usable explanation is available for this factor.
matching.rating_unavailable: Ratings are not available yet. No stars or default average are assumed.
matching.hours_inside: Within declared weekly hours for your preferred local day and time
matching.hours_outside: Outside declared weekly hours, but still eligible for this request
matching.experience_value: Relevant experience: {years} years, self-reported and not certified
matching.reliability_unavailable: Response and completion reliability are not calculated: there is not enough policy or evidence for a meaningful measure.
matching.rules_intro: Weights and scales come from the trusted server and cannot be edited here. These configurable weights are not claimed to be optimal.
matching.rule_weight: {factor}: weight {weight} of {total} ({share}% of the whole denominator).
matching.rules_neutral: Missing location, ratings, hours, or experience always use a neutral {neutral}/100. The whole denominator stays fixed for every provider; available factors are never reweighted per candidate.
matching.rules_scales: Known distance decreases on a capped {distance} km straight-line spherical scale, not a driving route or arrival estimate. Declared-hours coverage scores 100 within hours or 0 outside, without changing eligibility. Self-reported experience is capped at {years} years for scoring.
matching.tie_note: Ties use a deterministic order specific to this request, not names, account age, or completed jobs. Refresh for changes to eligibility, provider signals, and server rules.
matching.inputs_optional: Start blank; no device location or saved-request defaults
matching.location_guidance: Optionally enter a NEW broad matching point yourself, with at most two decimal places. Latitude is -90 to 90 and longitude -180 to 180; no grouping separators or exponents. Do not enter a private home or exact address. Nothing is copied from your request, address, or profile, and no location permission is used.
matching.query_consent: I agree to send this newly entered broad point to the server only for this matching query. It is ephemeral: not stored with or published on my request. No device location is read.
matching.time_guidance: Optionally enter a preferred day and time in the service area's local wall-clock time. This is separate from your saved request's preferred instant, is not converted between time zones, and is not a confirmed appointment. Enter both day and time, or leave both blank.
matching.previous_results: These are the previous applied results. Changed inputs or stale rules have not been applied to these rows; loading another page is paused.
matching.refreshing: Refreshing matching results; previous rows remain visible...
matching.empty_body: Discovery requires a currently verified provider, the matching active service and service-area label, and explicit provider consent. Missing optional signals alone never make a provider ineligible. Refresh to check again.
matching.demo_summary: Three synthetic plumbing/Cairo profiles, not real professionals
matching.demo_body: This local demo includes three explicitly synthetic plumbing profiles serving Cairo: the interactive Sample Marketplace Provider and two discovery-only examples with low or missing signals. Only marketplace-provider@salahly.demo can sign in and quote. The ordinary provider and new credential submissions remain pending or ineligible. Publish a separate plumbing listing with city Cairo to explore them. Enter any optional matching point and local day/time yourself; no private-request defaults are used. No invitations, quotes, or jobs are generated automatically. Data resets when the app restarts.
matching.settings_heading: Choose how you appear in matching
matching.settings_intro: These preferences are separate from provider onboarding and credential review. Creating an account or submitting a credential does not enable discovery. A currently verified profile with an active selected service and a service area is required to enable it; the server checks your current eligibility.
matching.settings_no_action: Opting in does not send invitations, create quotes, select you for work, or book an appointment. Existing quotes and jobs are separate.
matching.eligibility_each_request: Visibility is checked against current verification, active service, and service-area eligibility for each published open request, even when this preference is on.
matching.metadata_loading: Checking your current services and credential status...
matching.metadata_failed: Current service metadata could not be refreshed. Your matching preferences remain here; unknown or stale metadata is not approval to enable discovery.
matching.settings_ineligible: Discovery cannot be enabled without known current verified credentials, an active selected service, and a service area. You can still turn it off or save optional preferences privately.
matching.discovery_checkbox: Include me in eligible customer matching results
matching.discovery_private_note: Off excludes you from new matching results. You may save disabled discovery preferences privately without disclosure consent. Previously submitted quotes or accepted jobs are not removed.
matching.origin_guidance: Manually enter a broad SERVICE ORIGIN with at most two decimal places, never a private home or personal address. Leave both fields blank to omit distance. When discovery is enabled, repeated distance queries can reveal or approximate this origin, even if the raw coordinates are not shown. Do not treat it as secret. No GPS, maps, or location permissions are used.
matching.experience_guidance: For each current active selected service, optionally enter 0 to 60 whole years. A blank field means no signal; 0 is an explicit self-report. These years are not certified. Previously saved services that are no longer current can be removed, not presented as current skills.
matching.no_current_skills: No current active selected services are known. Manage provider setup or retry the service checks; no skills are assumed.
matching.old_experience: Previously saved experience for {category}; not a known current active service.
matching.private_save_note: With discovery off, these optional preferences are saved privately. No matching disclosure consent is required for that save.
matching.name_to_share: Current profile name to snapshot on this consented save: {name}
matching.settings_disclosure: Discovery shares your consented profile-name snapshot, optional relevant self-reported years, and matching explanations with customers who own eligible published open requests. Your optional service origin supports approximate straight-line distances and can be inferred from repeated queries; it is not a private address. Your private onboarding biography, contact details, credential images, and review notes are never included. Turning discovery off does not retract names already shared through quotes or jobs.
matching.provider_consent: I reviewed the name, optional service origin, and experience I am saving. I explicitly agree to this matching disclosure. Any edits require a fresh confirmation before an enabled save.
matching.settings_saved_discoverable: Discovery preferences saved with disclosure consent. Current eligibility is still required for matching.
matching.unsaved: Unsaved discovery edits. Nothing is sent until you save.
matching.discard_body: Your unsaved discovery choice, service origin, experience, and disclosure confirmation will be removed from this page. Previously saved preferences will not change.
matching.reload_body: Unsaved discovery edits and consent will be replaced by the latest saved preferences. Review the current name and details before consenting again.
matching.wait_save: Wait for the current discovery save to finish before leaving.
matching.resolve_before_leaving: Retry the original discovery save before leaving. Its outcome is still unknown.
matching.pending_note: The original immutable save is unresolved. Other edits and saves remain paused until the original retry resolves, including after reopening this page.

reasons.no_query_location: You did not provide a separate matching point, so there is no distance evidence.
reasons.no_provider_origin: This provider has no consented service origin, so there is no distance evidence.
reasons.straight_line: A spherical straight-line estimate from the optional broad matching point to the provider's approximate service origin, not a route or arrival estimate.
reasons.no_reviews: A review-based rating signal is not available yet; no average is fabricated.
reasons.no_time_preference: You did not enter a separate preferred local weekday and time, so hours are not compared.
reasons.no_declared_hours: The provider has not declared weekly hours, so there is no hours evidence.
reasons.within_hours: Your explicit service-area local weekday and time fall within the provider's self-declared weekly hours. This does not confirm availability or book a slot.
reasons.outside_hours: Your explicit local weekday and time are outside the provider's declared weekly hours. This affects the score, not hard eligibility or an appointment.
reasons.no_experience: The provider has not reported years for this request's service category.
reasons.self_reported: The provider reported years for this service category. It is not independently certified experience.

errors.access: This matching information is unavailable to the current session. Sign in with the owning customer or provider account.
errors.not_found: This request or matching profile is unavailable to your account.
errors.invalid: These matching details could not be validated. Refresh the current rules or saved preferences and review them again.
errors.consent: Explicitly confirm the matching-point or provider disclosure before sending these details.
errors.location: Enter both latitude and longitude with at most two decimal places, or leave both blank. Use latitude -90 to 90 and longitude -180 to 180, with no grouping separators or exponents.
errors.time: Enter both a local weekday and a valid HH:mm time from 00:00 to 23:59, or leave both blank.
errors.experience: Enter 0 to 60 whole years for current selected services, or leave them blank. Remove outdated service experience if necessary.
errors.ineligible: Current verified credentials, active selected services, and service areas are required to enable discovery. Signup and pending review are not approval.
errors.conflict: The saved discovery revision changed. No success is assumed. Reload the saved preferences and review them before another save.
errors.status: Matching is available only while this request is open. Use Quotes and sharing to view its current status.
errors.unpublished: Publish a separate listing in Quotes and sharing before exploring providers. Your private request is not published automatically.
errors.stale: The rules or pagination context changed. Refreshing must restart from the first page rather than combine incompatible results.
errors.busy: Wait for the current matching operation to finish.
errors.load_failed: Matching information could not be loaded. Previously loaded content is retained; try refreshing.
errors.uncertain: The original discovery save may already be recorded. Keep its details unchanged and retry that exact save; other edits and saves are paused.

notifications.title: Your notifications
notifications.empty_message: Important account and service updates will appear here.
notifications.not_found: This notification is no longer available. Refresh your inbox.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, up to 32 characters.
profile.city_length: Use a city name up to 100 characters.
profile.role_note: Your role is set at sign-up and cannot be edited here.
profile.provider_note: Creating a provider account does not verify your credentials. Open provider setup to view your review status.
profile.demo_note: Profile changes are local to this demo and are cleared on restart.

provider.title: Provider setup
provider.about_hint: Describe your experience and the work you offer. Use 20 to 1,000 characters before submitting for review.
provider.skills_hint: Choose at least one service. These are self-reported skills, not individual certifications.
provider.areas_hint: Add up to 10 cities or districts, one per line. Use clear area names, not a private home address.
provider.hours_hint: Choose at least one day in each service area's local time. These are not bookable slots. End time must follow start time; midnight as an end time means the end of that day.
provider.saved: Your provider details have been saved.
provider.unsaved: Unsaved changes. A selected document is uploaded only when you submit.
provider.discard_message: Your last saved details will remain. Unsaved edits and the selected document will be removed from this page.
provider.wait_operation: Wait for the current save or submission to finish before leaving.

status_hint.draft: Save your professional details, then send one credential for review. Your account is not verified.
status_hint.pending: Submission is not approval. Your submitted details are read-only until an authorized reviewer makes a decision.
status_hint.verified: An authorized reviewer approved your submitted credential. Service details remain self-reported. New quotes also require a matching active service and service-area label; weekly hours are not bookable appointments.
status_hint.rejected: Read the review note, update your details, and submit a new document when ready.

provider.document_hint: One clear JPEG or PNG image, up to 5 MiB. Use a relevant trade certificate or professional credential. PDF files are not supported yet.
provider.privacy_note: Private to you and authorized reviewers. Avoid unnecessary personal information. This prototype is for sample documents until the operator publishes a privacy and retention policy.
provider.demo_note: Demo only: the sample document stays in this app's memory and resets on restart. No real review or approval takes place.
provider.consent: I agree to share this document and my submitted profile with authorized reviewers for credential verification.
provider.submitted: Your submission is saved and awaiting review. It is not approval.

errors.invalid_profile: Check your provider details and try again.

errors.skills: Choose 1 to 20 available services. Remove any unavailable service before saving.
errors.areas: Use 1 to 10 unique area names, each between 2 and 100 characters.
errors.availability: Choose at least one day with an end time after its start time. Split overnight hours across separate days.
errors.incomplete: Complete your introduction, services, areas, and weekly hours before submitting.
errors.consent: Agree to the review before submitting this document.

errors.document_required: Choose a document image before submitting.

errors.document_type: Choose a valid JPEG or PNG image. Other file types are not supported.
errors.document_size: Choose a non-empty document image no larger than 5 MiB.
errors.upload: The upload or submission could not be confirmed. Check review status before retrying.
errors.pick: The image picker could not be opened. Try again and check photo access if needed.
